_README: Golden set for the LLM claim pre-fill (P1). Each example holds the extractor inputs (abstract, statement, topics) and the hand-curated 'gold' review fields a human would accept. '_recorded' is the model suggestion last captured for the SAME prompt: `scripts/eval_claim_prefill.py --record-live` (AI_PROVIDER=anthropic) overwrites it from a real call AND reports live accuracy vs gold; `scripts/eval_claim_prefill.py --write-fixtures` replays it into tests/fixtures/ai/ so CI runs offline and deterministically (AI_PROVIDER=cache). The offline eval therefore measures a REGRESSION of the recorded outputs against gold, not a fresh live call -- '_recorded' deliberately diverges from 'gold' on the harder cases so the numbers stay honest. evidence_strength uses the prompt vocabulary low|moderate|high (Anhang A); null means the abstract does not support that field. DO NOT wire these into data/ -- they are an evaluation artifact only.

_recorded.context: Synthesis of 18 classroom studies of AI literacy instruction in European primary schools.
